title: Sticky note's icon should use icon with corresponding color
line: A Sticky Note in a panel now shows an icon in the note's own color.
explanation: The Sticky Note applet used the shell's default compact representation, which can only show the static knotes-symbolic icon name from Plasmoid.icon, so every note in a panel looked the same whatever its color. The applet already has NotesHelper.noteIcon(color), which draws the colored note from the theme's notes SVG for the context menu's color items. The applet now has its own compact representation (a Kirigami.Icon with the same click, keyboard, drag-hover and size behaviour as the default one) whose source is that colored note icon; transparent notes keep the symbolic icon, since they have no color of their own.

commits.message:
applets/notes: show the note's color in its compact icon

In a panel every note showed the same generic icon, so with several
notes there was no way to tell them apart. The compact icon now shows
the same colored note as the context menu, except for transparent notes.

BUG: 477008

media.caption: Red, green, yellow and transparent notes in the panel: four identical icons
Same notes: red, green and yellow icons, the transparent one keeps the plain icon
